name: Workspace Control
author: jcallico
description: A growing toolkit of workspace-related features for Omarchy. First feature: restores every window to its exact workspace, position and size after a reboot, logout or crash.

barWidget.description: Watches your Hyprland layout per workspace and restores it on login.

schema.label: Watch for layout changes
schema.description: Automatically re-save a workspace's layout a couple of seconds after you open, close, move, float, pin, or fullscreen a window on it.

schema.label: Restore on login
schema.description: Once per login, put every saved window back on its workspace at its exact position and size.

schema.label: Save debounce (seconds)
schema.description: How long to wait after the last layout change on a workspace before saving it.

schema.label: Safety-net rescan (minutes)
schema.description: How often to fully resync the saved layout with the live session, as a backstop to the event-driven and geometry-poll saves.

schema.label: Excluded app classes
schema.description: Comma-separated window classes to never save or restore (e.g. launcher popups, one-off dialogs).
